messages.author: 553bb11ffc45ec76
messages.subject: subhead v1.6.2 SAM_pairer_finish_margins: Assertion `Sbin' failed.
parts:
Full error message: 
=====
featureCounts: input-files.c:4494: SAM_pairer_finish_margins: Assertion `Sbin' failed.
Aborted
=====

I'm experiencing this error in a Single-Cell RNA-seq situation. I couldn't find answer for this in google search, and I want to ask it here because it succeed on other 3004 cells but failed in 1. 

I've 3005 cells, I finished STAR for each of them and have Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam successfully. And when I run featureCounts on those STAR output bam files, all 3004 succeed, but 1 failed. 

I checked and re-run STAR and featureCounts on this failed one manually, featureCounts raised the same error and aborted immediately. 

I think the error is reproducible:

The accession number for the cell that failed is: GSM1476865. 

STAR and featureCounts command is as following. 

#STAR 2.6.0(index are generated as in STAR manual)

@path/STAR-2.6.0a/bin/Linux_x86_64/STAR --runThreadN 1 --outFileNamePrefix @mypath/GSM1476865/ --outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM GeneCounts --genomeDir @STAR_index_generated_as_in_STAR_mannual --readFilesIn @path/SRR1547789.fastq


featureCounts -t exon -g gene_id -f -J -a @path/gencode.vM17.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf -G @path/GRCm38.primary_assembly.genome.fa -o @output_file @/GSM1476865/Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam


#annotation file, primary_assembly annotation for Mouse from Gencode

gencode.vM17.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf

GRCm38.primary_assembly.genome.fa

messages.subject: Re: subhead v1.6.2 SAM_pairer_finish_margins: Assertion `Sbin' failed.
parts:
Thanks for the bug report!  I used the same setting to first map a single-cell data set by STAR, then assign the mapping results to an annotation file. No error was reported.

Can you provide the mapping result from STAR (the BAM file), the reference genome (the FASTA file) and the annotation (the gtf file)?

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: subhead v1.6.2 SAM_pairer_finish_margins: Assertion `Sbin' failed.
parts:
Is it possible if you provide the mapping result from STAR (the BAM file), the reference genome (the FASTA file) and the annotation (the gtf file)? 

It is very important to us because we thought featureCounts is (or should be) bulletproof so we are keen to find bugs in featureCounts and remove them.

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: subhead v1.6.2 SAM_pairer_finish_margins: Assertion `Sbin' failed.
parts:
Thanks for the data! I can reproduce the error using your data. 

I found a bug in featureCounts: one of the gzipped block in your BAM file is very small (only 96 bytes), and it is the first gzipped block read by a thread. The thread tried to find the start of the first read in the gzipped block, but there isn't one because it is too small. FeatureCounts will fall back into the "safe mode" when it sees such a situation (the safe mode is much slower, but it can cope this situation), but there is a variable (the margin table) not correctly initiated when the mode was switched. This scenario is extremely rare, so thanks very much for the bug report.

This bug has been fixed. Before our next release, you can use Samtools or Picard to sort the BAM file first (no matter what the order is), then use featureCounts on the sorted BAM files.
